pages.text: All damage is classified into 8 types:$(br)$(#C0C0C0)Slashing$() - blades$(br)$(#8B4513)Blunt$() - hammers, explosions, falls$(br)$(#DAA520)Piercing$() - arrows, spikes$(br)$(#9370DB)Magic$() - potions, magic damage$(br)$(#FF4500)Fire$()$(br)$(#87CEEB)Lightning$()$(br)$(#4B0082)Dark$() - wither$(br)$(#FFD700)Holy$()

$(2)How is damage classified?$()$(br)Every vanilla damage source carries an ID (e.g. minecraft:arrow). $(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)damage_type_mappings.json$() translates them into types - including $(o)mixed distributions$().$(br2)Unknown modded damage types are auto-scanned into the mapping table via tag inference, so modded content works out of the box.
